item.title: Winn Community Health Center’s three-story complex nears completion
item.description: Residents have watched as Winn Community Health Center has grown from its 2,000 square foot building with a small client base in July 2009 to a multi-parish, nine-site health service with over 500 employees and last year surpassed its 1 million patient mark. item.title: Caddo Conference will take place at NSU March 27-28
item.description: The Caddo Conference Organization/Louisiana Archaeological Society will hold their annual meeting at Northwestern State University March 27-28. Members will present papers and posters of Caddo archaeology, history and culture. The purpose of the CCO is to promote interest in the Caddo ethnography of the Caddo region, southwestern Arkansas, northwestern Louisiana, southeastern Oklahoma and northeastern Texas and … Continue reading Caddo Conference will take place at NSU March 27-28

item.title: Shreveport man cited in Lafourche Parish hunting violations, faces multiple charges
item.description: A Shreveport man was among two individuals cited by Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries enforcement agents for alleged hunting violations during a Jan. 25 patrol in Lafourche Parish. item.title: Regional law enforcement offering disability decal initiative
item.description: The Caddo Parish Sheriff’s Office, along with regional agencies, is offering a Voluntary Disability Decal Program to enhance communication and safety for individuals with special needs.
